title: G02: requirement-decomposition gate contract (requirements / nfr / traceability / definition-of-ready), planned fresh from #46
objective: Enforce Gate 02, already declared in lifecycle.json but unbacked: give its four required_evidence types per-type rules in validate_evidence, exactly as G01's check_prd / check_acceptance_criteria / check_product_approval, so the gate OPENS each artifact. Ship examples/gate-dossier.G02.json (validated in CI) and prove an instance advances G01->G02 on a valid G02 dossier.
business_value: Without per-type rules a G02 dossier passes on names alone -- the G01 defect class (a name is not evidence) one gate downstream. This makes 'NFRs quantified' and 'bidirectional traceability established' deterministic gate refusals rather than prose.
in_scope: check_requirements / check_nfr / check_traceability / check_definition_of_ready in badf_gate.py + registration in EVIDENCE_RULES
examples/gate-dossier.G02.json + its four evidence/artifact pairs; CI validates it
tests/test_badf_g02.py (failing-first) + a G01->G02 pair-acceptance in tests/test_badf_advance.py
mutation; own G07 self-dossier; doctrine section in GITHUB_CONTROL_PLANE.md
out_of_scope: the badf-requirements authoring skill (a later WP)
the capability/epic identity hierarchy from #46's fuller scope
any vendored Spec-Kit; any competing scripts/badf_requirements.py validator
PR #47's branch -- untouched; it gets a separate REV verdict
acceptance_criteria: an RTM with an orphan requirement or an uncovered acceptance criterion is refused, naming it
an unquantified NFR (no numeric target value) is refused
a requirement whose objective_refs miss the RTM's objective universe is refused
a definition-of-ready missing one of the four G02 exit criteria is refused
an instance at G01/APPROVED advances to G02/APPROVED on a valid G02 dossier
mutation kills; compose green both shapes; PyYAML-absent suite green

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR

note: Lands IN_PROGRESS by design; the next WP reconciles it. Reuses the G01 substrate -- no new validator module. G02's own minimum_change_class for instances is C1 (lifecycle.json); this WP that BUILDS the G02 gate is C2, mirroring WP-0030 which built G01.
